title: ACA / Gazette NGR / Outlook India — NPT RevCon 후속 전문가 사후 평가: Kimball 'rhetorical support strong but foundations cracking', 'missed important opportunity to reaffirm', 미-이란 충돌 상세
snippet: Daryl Kimball, executive director of the Arms Control Association: 'Rhetorical support for the NPT is strong, but the foundations of the NPT are cracking due to inaction, inattention, and intransigence on the part of the major powers.' 'NPT states missed an important opportunity to formally reaffirm their support for the treaty and its core principles, goals, and objectives at a time of increasing nuclear dangers.' Rebecca Johnson criticized both US and Russia for 'double down on nuclear threats, blame others.'
tag_reason: 5/24 보고서에서 NPT RevCon 합의 실패 의장 선언을 보도했으나, 금일 발견된 ACA 사후 평가는 회의 폐회 후 발표된 전문가 구조적 분석으로, '토대 균열(foundations cracking)' 진단과 미-이란 충돌 상세 등 새로운 분석적 관점을 제공.
